# Check — M0-a-15, the arena block: closing check of the kernel's consolidation round R12 (lane check/M0-a-15-consolidate-close-1, flow-7, 2026-10-13)

**Verdict: PASS.** This checker re-ran each of the round's four lines (O-1, O-2 / O-3, API frozen, NO-SHIFT) against
its oracle with its own evidence, and each one is fixed. No new finding is a blocker. The round changes no behaviour:

* **Bytes, digests and refusals.** Two seeded NO-SHIFT probes ran on the true pre-round sources and on the round's
  sources, and both sides gave byte-identical output:
  * the kernel probe (1 250 lines, sha256 `a48cb2e2…`);
  * the testkit probe (859 lines, sha256 `0f34ab63…`).

  The pre-round sources are main's base commit `23d13d5`, fetched read-only through the GitHub contents API (no git).
  The probes cover every chunk's bytes and ref, the loaded arena's print and its five level digests, and the decoder's
  code and detail text on 400 deterministic re-hashed corruptions. They also cover `inRange` on a 21 × 21 table of
  edge values.
* **Lawful refusals.** The lawful round trips refuse nothing: 0 before and 0 after.
* **Exports.** The TypeScript checker lists the same 16 names for `io/index.ts` and the same 673 for the barrel, before
  and after. The 16 io names are exactly API.md Appendix B's io row.
* **Mutants.** 28 targeted mutants ran. 27 are red, among them the plan's oracle mutants K3 – K8, K10, K11 and K9. K12
  survives, as recorded (note 13).
* **Comments.** Every rewritten comment matches the code.

The gates were install, lint (probe-red ok), build, landed:verify, NEAR (10 files, 127 / 127, at the PR size) and
RELATED@1000 (407 files, 5 266 / 5 266). Every one exits 0. Two notes rows, 16 and 17, go to `checks/M0-a-15-notes.md`.

Seat: closing checker, independent of the author (`build/M0-a-15-consolidate-1`, L-0493 in this tree). The lane log had
no earlier line for this lane key, so the check started fresh. The checker planned and ran its probes and its mutants
first. Only then did it read the author's round-C1 notes section. It judges that section here and does not use it as
evidence. Machine: `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib` (the J198 id matches). Node v24.12.0. The
worker budget was 1 (`tools/test_budget.py` printed 1, mutant budget 1), and one test process ran at a time. No timing
was taken or gated on. No git command was run.

## Method

* **The before-image.** The landed record's snapshot (`flow-7.json`) holds hashes, not contents, and it predates the
  io files. The author's before-mirror was deleted. So the checker fetched the item's 19 owned files at `23d13d5` with
  `gh api -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" repos/…/contents/plat/<path>?ref=23d13d5`. That commit is the session's
  base on main, and this round ran on top of it. 13 of the files equal the tree. The six that differ are exactly the
  round's six: `src/io/{bytes,decode,encode,format,index}.ts` and `test/io/corrupt.test.ts`.
* **The mirror.** One whole copy of `plat/` (tar, no `node_modules`), installed with `install --frozen-lockfile
  --offline`, at `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-15/mirror`.
  * It served the mutants and the after-runs of the probes.
  * With the five pre-round sources swapped in, it served the before-runs.
  * Every mutant and every swap was restored. `diff -r` of the mirror's `kernel/src/io`, `kernel/test/io` and
    `testkit/test/kernel/io` against the tree showed no difference.
  * The probe files lived only in the mirror and are kept in the scratchpad (`zz-noshift-*.test.ts.keep`).
  * The mirror's `node_modules` were deleted at the end.
* **The diff of the round, read whole** (pre-round → tree):
  * `bytes.ts`: one comment phrase.
  * `decode.ts`: `FREE_KIND` moves from a private `const FREE_KIND = 0xffff` to the arena's import, and
    `VERTEX_FLAG_MASK` gains a doc.
  * `encode.ts`: six doc lines on `onward` / `runsAt`. No code changed.
  * `format.ts`: the `isLatticeCoord` import, the `inRange` body, and the `HALF`, `SPAN`, `inRange` and `roomFor` docs.
  * `index.ts`: the comment only. The export lines are byte-identical.
  * `corrupt.test.ts`: lines 269 – 303 added, nothing removed.

| **O-1** comment only (J263 Q7) | The pre-round → tree diff of `encode.ts` adds only lines 70 – 75, inside the `onward` doc block. The `onward` and `runsAt` bodies and their five `fail` texts are byte-identical. The new doc says the encoder's level-r route edge is "a piece of `routePieces(p, routeRun(p, h), r)`". Read against `index/items.ts:87–153` (`onward` and `routeRun`, which cut at the run's own level m) and `:168–186` (`routePieces`, which cuts at level ≤ n), this holds. Where `runsAt(p, r)` walks past a vertex of level > r, `routeRun` walks past it too (its level is also > m, because m ≤ r). Where `runsAt` stops at a vertex of level ≤ r, `routePieces(…, r)` cuts there. Both orient from the lower (y, x) end (`compareVertices`). The three structural refusals the doc names are exactly the code's `fail`s: a loop off one vertex (`a === b`), a run that mixes levels, and a vertex inside a run without exactly two edges of level ≤ r (`onward`). `index/items.ts:163–166` (R5's doc, C-0345 (2)) says the same thing from the other side. ## (3) New findings: none is a blocker

The checker re-checked the blocker classes, and none applies:

* Every gate exits 0.
* The four listed interfaces `encodeArena`, `decodeArena`, `ChunkRef` and `compactSlots`, and every listed test, are
  present. Every pre-round describe and it title is kept: a regex census gives 56 titles before and 57 after, none
  missing, and the one addition is the new corrupt case.
* No stub, shortcut or TODO was added.
* There is no wrong result on an honest input (NO-SHIFT).
* No file outside `plat/` was touched or read for the item, and there was no clean-room breach.

The author's notes section (round C1) agrees with this checker's evidence. Its claims check out:

* the six files;
* 30 it before and 31 after;
* the O2/O3/K results;
* K9 now killed and K12 surviving.

Two notes rows go to `checks/M0-a-15-notes.md`:

* **16:** `decode.ts`'s module comment states the load order without the vertices step. The text is pre-round and
  not rewritten here.
* **17, for the session:** this tree's C-0346 and L-0493 collide with main's (C-0104: the next writer renumbers).

They are recorded as `check-M0-a-15-notes` under this lane.
